scholarships.scholarshipName: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (Degree)
scholarships.providerName: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.description: The AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to specially-abled students with disability of not less than 40% pursuing first year of technical degree programmes in AICTE-approved institutions.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Student must have a certified disability of 40% or more (UDID certificate). Admitted to 1st year of technical degree course in an AICTE approved institution. Family income from all sources must not exceed INR 8 Lakh per annum.

scholarships.scholarshipName: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (Diploma)
scholarships.providerName: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.description: Financial assistance for specially-abled students with not less than 40% disability admitted to the 1st year of a technical diploma course in an AICTE approved institution.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Differently-abled students with >= 40% benchmark disability admitted into AICTE-approved diploma programmes. Annual family income must not exceed INR 8 Lakh.

scholarships.scholarshipName: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree)
scholarships.providerName: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.description: AICTE scheme aimed at empowering young women by providing financial aid for technical degree education. Up to two girl children per family are eligible.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Open exclusively to female students admitted to the first year of degree level course in AICTE approved institutions. Family income must be less than INR 8 Lakh per annum.

scholarships.providerName: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.description: AICTE Swanath scheme supports orphans, children whose both parents died due to COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred in action.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Candidate must be an orphan, or lost both parents during COVID-19, or ward of Armed Forces/Paramilitary personnel martyred in action. Studying in AICTE-approved degree or diploma institution.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.providerName: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
scholarships.description: Central Sector scheme under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment offering maintenance allowance, disability allowance, and book grants for higher education students with disabilities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Must possess a valid UDID card with 40% or more benchmark disability. Enrolled in post-matriculation courses (Class 11 to Post-Graduate degree/diploma) in recognized institutions. Annual parental income must not exceed INR 2.50 Lakh.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.providerName: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)
scholarships.description: Central Sector scheme providing financial assistance to school students with disabilities in Class 9 and 10 to reduce drop-out rates.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Students with >= 40% certified disability studying in Class 9th or 10th in a government or government-recognized school. Annual family income must not exceed INR 2.50 Lakh.

scholarships.scholarshipName: National Fellowship for Persons with Disabilities (NFPwD)
scholarships.providerName: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities & UGC
scholarships.description: Prestigious fellowship providing 200 annual awards for students with disabilities pursuing full-time M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees in Indian universities and research institutes.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Candidate must have >= 40% disability and must have qualified the UGC-NET or CSIR-NET examination and secured admission in regular full-time Ph.D./M.Phil programmes.

scholarships.providerName: Ministry of Education, Government of India
scholarships.description: The PMRF scheme offers highest-tier doctoral fellowships for top talent in Science and Technology in IITs, IISc Bangalore, and central research universities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: B.Tech/M.Sc/M.Tech graduates with CGPA of 8.0 or higher from recognized institutions, or valid GATE score of 650 or higher. Enrolled in doctoral programme at PMRF-granting institute.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
scholarships.providerName: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
scholarships.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for top-percentile students who have completed Class 12 pursuing regular graduate and post-graduate studies.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in relevant stream from respective board of examination in Class 12. Gross family income up to INR 4.50 Lakh per annum.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
scholarships.providerName: University Grants Commission (UGC)
scholarships.description: UGC special scholarship scheme to promote higher education among students from the North Eastern states of India.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Domicile of North Eastern states (NER) passed Class 12 or equivalent. Admitted into first year of any general, technical or professional degree course. Family income below INR 4.50 Lakh.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
scholarships.providerName: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
scholarships.description: Central Sector scheme covering full tuition, living expenses, and computer allowances for Scheduled Caste students admitted to notified premier institutes (IITs, IIMs, NITs, NLUs, AIIMS).
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Scheduled Caste student admitted to an empaneled top institution. Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 8.00 Lakh.

qualifications: 12th Standard or Bachelor's admission into empaneled institute

scholarships.providerName: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
scholarships.description: DST scheme to attract talented youth to study basic and natural sciences at undergraduate and master levels with handsome mentorship and research components.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Top 1% in Class 12 board examinations enrolled in natural and basic sciences (B.Sc., B.S., Int. M.Sc.), or top 10,000 ranks in JEE / NEET joining basic science degrees.

scholarships.scholarshipName: National Overseas Scholarship for SC, De-notified Nomadic Tribes and Landless Agricultural Labourers
scholarships.providerName: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
scholarships.description: Centrally sponsored prestigious scholarship enabling low-income Indian students to pursue Master's and Ph.D. degrees in top international universities worldwide.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Belonging to SC, DNT, or traditional artisan families. Must have secured unconditional admission to a university ranked in top 500 QS world rankings. Total family income must not exceed INR 8.00 Lakh per annum. Age below 35 years.

scholarships.scholarshipName: UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Humanities and Social Sciences
scholarships.providerName: University Grants Commission (UGC)
scholarships.description: National level fellowship for candidates qualifying the National Eligibility Test (NET) for doctoral research across Indian universities and colleges.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwD/OBC-NCL). Qualified UGC-NET JRF within the prescribed age limit (30 years for general, relaxation for reserved categories and women).

qualifications: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks

scholarships.scholarshipName: Post Matric Scholarships Scheme for Minorities
scholarships.providerName: Ministry of Minority Affairs
scholarships.description: Empowers students from notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis) pursuing higher secondary and university education.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Notified minority community members who secured not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination. Annual family income not exceeding INR 2.00 Lakh.

scholarships.providerName: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs
scholarships.description: The flagship international educational exchange program sponsored by the U.S. government, bringing graduate students, young professionals and artists from abroad to study in the United States.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizens of participating countries who have completed undergraduate education and hold a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree. Leadership potential and English proficiency required.

scholarships.providerName: U.S. Department of State & Institute of International Education
scholarships.description: Provides ten months of non-degree academic study and related professional experiences in the United States for experienced mid-career professionals from designated countries.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Mid-career professionals in leadership positions with minimum five years of full-time professional experience, commitment to public service, and demonstrated leadership.

scholarships.providerName: U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid
scholarships.description: Federal need-based grant program providing up to $7,395 per academic year to undergraduate students with exceptional financial need.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: U.S. citizens or eligible noncitizens enrolled in an undergraduate degree or certificate program at a participating institution, demonstrating exceptional financial need via FAFSA.

scholarships.scholarshipName: The Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans
scholarships.providerName: Paul & Daisy Soros Foundation
scholarships.description: Premier graduate school fellowship for immigrants and children of immigrants in the United States, providing up to $90,000 in funding over two years.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Immigrants or children of immigrants (New Americans) aged 30 or younger pursuing full-time graduate degree in any field at an accredited US university.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Lime Connect Fellowship Program for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.providerName: Lime Connect Inc.
scholarships.description: Designed for high-achieving university students who have a visible or non-visible disability, providing leadership development, networking with top global corporations, and educational stipend.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Current undergraduate sophomore students with a disability (visible or invisible, including mental health conditions and chronic illnesses) studying at an accredited university in the US.

scholarships.scholarshipName: AAHD Frederick J. Krause Scholarship on Health and Disability
scholarships.providerName: American Association on Health and Disability
scholarships.description: Awarded annually to students with disabilities pursuing undergraduate or graduate studies in health-related fields, disability studies, public health, or rehabilitation.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Applicant must have a documented disability as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), enrolled full-time as undergraduate junior/senior or graduate student in an accredited U.S. college.

scholarships.providerName: Microsoft Corporation & Lime Connect
scholarships.description: Enables high school seniors living with disabilities to attend undergraduate programmes in technology, engineering, computer science, and business.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: High school senior with a living disability (visual, hearing, mobility, cognitive, speech or other) planning to enroll in a full-time undergraduate course in technology or engineering.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Google Student Veterans of America Scholarship
scholarships.providerName: Google & Student Veterans of America
scholarships.description: Provides $10,000 scholarship and attendance at Google's annual Scholars' Retreat for student veterans pursuing computer science degrees.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Currently enrolled as an undergraduate or graduate student in computer science or related field at an accredited US university with honorable discharge or active duty military status.

qualifications: Undergraduate or graduate standing in CS

scholarships.providerName: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
scholarships.description: Long-term development awards administered by DFAT. They provide opportunities for people from developing countries, particularly Indo-Pacific region, to undertake full-time undergraduate or postgraduate study at Australian universities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizen of an eligible participating country (including India, South Asia, Southeast Asia, Pacific). Minimum 18 years of age. Commits to returning home for at least two years upon completion.

qualifications: Completed secondary or bachelor degree depending on level

scholarships.providerName: Australian Government Department of Education
scholarships.description: Commonwealth-funded Research Training Program providing full tuition offsets and living cost stipends for domestic and international students undertaking Research Doctorate and Research Master degrees.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Enrolled or accepted in an accredited Higher Degree by Research (HDR) course at an eligible Australian Higher Education Provider. High academic achievement and research capability.

qualifications: First-class Honours or equivalent Master's degree

scholarships.providerName: University of Melbourne
scholarships.description: Offered to high-achieving domestic and international research students undertaking graduate research degrees at the University of Melbourne, including full fee offsets and bi-weekly stipends.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Applied for and met entry requirements for a graduate research degree at the University of Melbourne. Ranked based on academic achievement in previous studies.

qualifications: Four-year bachelor degree with first-class honours or equivalent master

scholarships.providerName: University of Sydney
scholarships.description: Provides a 20 percent contribution towards tuition fees for the duration of the undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree at the University of Sydney.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: International student holding citizenship of an eligible regional country (including India, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia). Applying for full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree.

qualifications: High school diploma or bachelor degree depending on level

scholarships.providerName: Australian National University (ANU)
scholarships.description: Prestigious award providing 25% or 50% tuition fee reduction to top international undergraduate and postgraduate coursework students at Australia's national university.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: International student with an active offer of admission at ANU. Assessed automatically based on previous academic qualifications.

qualifications: Top percentile secondary or undergraduate score

scholarships.providerName: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
scholarships.description: Short-term study, research, and professional development fellowship aimed at emerging mid-career leaders and specialists in priority development sectors.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Nominated by an Australian host organization in partnership with international counterpart organization in eligible developing countries.

scholarships.providerName: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO), UK Government
scholarships.description: The UK government's global scholarship programme, funded by the FCDO and partner organizations. Offers fully funded one-year master's degrees at any UK university for future leaders.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizen of a Chevening-eligible country (including India, Commonwealth countries, global south). Hold undergraduate degree equivalent to an upper second-class 2:1 honours degree. At least two years of work experience.
eligibleSubjects: All one-year taught master's degree courses at UK universities

scholarships.providerName: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) to enable talented and motivated individuals to gain the knowledge and skills required for sustainable development.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizen or permanent resident of an eligible Commonwealth country (including India). Hold a first degree of at least upper second-class (2:1) honours standard. Unable to afford to study in the UK without scholarship.

scholarships.providerName: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: Supports full-time doctoral study at UK universities for high-achieving candidates from low and middle income Commonwealth countries.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizen of an eligible Commonwealth country. Hold an appropriate master's degree. Provide clear proposal with potential impact on development in home country.

qualifications: Master's degree with merit or distinction

scholarships.providerName: British Council & UK Government GREAT Britain Campaign
scholarships.description: Joint initiative offering £10,000 towards tuition fees for one-year postgraduate courses in the UK across participating British universities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Passport holder of participating countries (including India, Bangladesh, China, Ghana, Kenya, Nigeria, Pakistan, Thailand, Turkey). Hold an undergraduate degree and an offer from a participating UK university.
eligibleSubjects: Wide range of subjects including STEM, Business, Law, Humanities, Climate Justice

qualifications: Undergraduate degree matching university entrance criteria

scholarships.scholarshipName: Rhodes Scholarships at the University of Oxford
scholarships.providerName: The Rhodes Trust / University of Oxford
scholarships.description: Oldest and among the most prestigious international scholarship programmes in the world, enabling outstanding young people from around the world to study at Oxford.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Graduating senior or recent graduate with exceptional academic achievement, moral character, and commitment to service. Eligible constituencies include India, USA, Australia, Canada, Germany, Singapore, New Zealand, and Global constituency.
eligibleSubjects: All full-time postgraduate degree courses at the University of Oxford

qualifications: Undergraduate degree with first class or GPA 3.7+

scholarships.providerName: Gates Cambridge Trust / University of Cambridge
scholarships.description: Prestigious full-cost scholarship for outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizen of any country outside the United Kingdom applying to pursue a PhD or one-year postgraduate course at Cambridge. Selection on intellectual ability, leadership, and commitment to improving lives of others.
eligibleSubjects: All courses available at the University of Cambridge with limited exclusions

qualifications: First class or high 2:1 honours degree

scholarships.providerName: Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst (DAAD)
scholarships.description: Scholarships for professionals from developing and emerging countries to pursue master's and doctoral degrees at state-recognized German universities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Bachelor's degree with above-average results, at least two years of professional experience in development-related sector. Citizenship of a DAC-listed developing country (including India).

scholarships.scholarshipName: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (Public Policy and Good Governance)
scholarships.providerName: Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst (DAAD)
scholarships.description: Designed to qualify future leaders in politics, law, economics, and administration according to principles of good governance at German universities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Graduates from developing and emerging countries with undergraduate degree in political science, law, economics, or social sciences. Above-average academic record.

qualifications: Bachelor's degree in social sciences, law or economics

scholarships.providerName: Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)
scholarships.description: Provides financial and non-material support to high-achieving and committed students from all over the world at all participating German universities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Enrolled or about to commence studies at a participating German higher education institution. Awarded based on academic merit, social engagement, and personal obstacles.
eligibleSubjects: All degree subjects taught in German universities

qualifications: University entrance qualification or bachelor degree

scholarships.providerName: Heinrich Böll Stiftung
scholarships.description: Supports German and international students and doctoral candidates of all disciplines who are committed to green political values, democracy, and human rights.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: International students accepted into a master's or PhD programme at a state-recognized university in Germany. Excellent academic standing and socio-political commitment.

scholarships.scholarshipName: DAAD Research Grants — Doctoral Programmes in Germany
scholarships.providerName: Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst (DAAD)
scholarships.description: Provides monthly grants and health insurance for excellently-qualified foreign doctoral candidates to pursue their complete doctorate in Germany.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Master's degree or equivalent completed within the last 6 years with excellent results. Admission or invitation letter from a German doctoral supervisor.

scholarships.providerName: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs & Campus France
scholarships.description: Developed by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students for master's and doctoral degree programmes.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Non-French nationality. Up to 25 years old for master's level, up to 30 years old for PhD level. Candidates are presented directly by French higher education institutions.

scholarships.providerName: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science & Nuffic
scholarships.description: Financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science along with participating Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Nationality non-EEA. Applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch higher education institution. Never studied at an educational institution in the Netherlands before.

qualifications: Meet admission criteria of participating Dutch institution

scholarships.scholarshipName: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SI GP)
scholarships.providerName: Swedish Institute (SI) / Swedish Ministry for Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: Fully funded academic scholarship by the Swedish Ministry for Foreign Affairs for global professionals pursuing full-time master's degrees in Sweden.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizen of an eligible country (including India, South Africa, Vietnam, etc.). Minimum 3,000 hours of demonstrated employment/work experience. Admitted to an eligible master's programme in Sweden.
eligibleSubjects: Eligible master's programmes in sustainability, innovation, technology, governance, human rights

qualifications: Bachelor's degree and 3,000 hours certified work experience

scholarships.scholarshipName: Swedish Institute Partner Region Master's Scholarships
scholarships.providerName: Swedish Institute (SI)
scholarships.description: Swedish Institute scholarships aimed at fostering democratic governance, green transition and economic resilience for talented international scholars.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizens of participating regional countries. Admitted to a designated English-taught master's programme in Sweden.

scholarships.providerName: Finnish National Agency for Education (EDUFI) & Finnish Universities
scholarships.description: Funded by the Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture, offering a 100% first-year tuition waiver and a EUR 5,000 relocation grant for non-EU/EEA students.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Non-EU/EEA students liable for tuition fees who apply for international master's programmes at participating Finnish universities during joint application.

qualifications: Applicable bachelor's degree with excellent academic standing

scholarships.providerName: Finnish National Agency for Education (EDUFI)
scholarships.description: Targeted at visiting doctoral students and young researchers from outside Finland to undertake research visits of 3 to 12 months at Finnish university departments.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Doctoral student enrolled at a foreign university visiting a Finnish university department, or candidate doing double degree.
eligibleSubjects: All academic fields represented in Finnish universities

qualifications: Enrolled doctoral student with confirmed hosting professor in Finland

scholarships.scholarshipName: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
scholarships.providerName: Higher Education Authority (HEA), Department of Further and Higher Education, Ireland
scholarships.description: Provides full tuition fee waiver plus EUR 10,000 stipend for one study year for high-calibre non-EU/EEA students studying in Irish higher education institutions.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Non-EU/EEA citizen with an offer of admission to an eligible Irish Higher Education Institution for master's, PhD, or final year undergraduate degree.
eligibleSubjects: All eligible academic disciplines in Irish universities

qualifications: Undergraduate degree with first class honours

scholarships.providerName: European Commission / EACEA
scholarships.description: High-level integrated master programmes designed and delivered by an international partnership of European higher education institutions across at least three different countries.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Students worldwide who have obtained a first higher education degree or demonstrate a recognised equivalent level of learning. Full coverage of participation costs, travel, and monthly allowance.
eligibleSubjects: Over 150 joint master programmes in Technology, Science, Humanities, Health, Environment

scholarships.providerName: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
scholarships.description: Collaboration between A*STAR, NTU, NUS, and SUTD providing international students with up to 4 years of PhD research funding in biomedical sciences, physical sciences, and engineering.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Open to all international graduates with passion for research and excellent academic results. Full tuition fees, monthly stipend of SGD 2,200 to SGD 2,700, airfare grant, and settling-in allowance.

qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree with good academic standing

scholarships.providerName: Singapore University of Technology and Design
scholarships.description: Prestigious award offered to outstanding PhD candidates worldwide. Includes full tuition coverage and monthly stipend of SGD 3,000 for up to 4 years.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Open to international candidates applying to full-time PhD programmes at SUTD. Exemplary academic achievement and research potential.

qualifications: Bachelor's degree with First Class Honours or equivalent

scholarships.scholarshipName: A*STAR Computing and Information Science Scholarship
scholarships.providerName: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
scholarships.description: Attracts top computing talents to pursue PhD training in computer science, cybersecurity, and data science at NUS, NTU, or SUTD in Singapore.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Open to international applicants who achieved top academic results in computer science or mathematics.

qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's in computing related field

scholarships.scholarshipName: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship for Research Students
scholarships.providerName: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
scholarships.description: Prestigious Japanese government scholarship covering full tuition, monthly stipend of 143,000 to 145,000 JPY, and return airfare for international graduate research students.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Applicants must hold nationality of a country having diplomatic relations with Japan. Born on or after April 2, 1990. Hold a university degree equivalent to Japanese university graduate.
eligibleSubjects: All fields of study matching Japanese universities

qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree (minimum 16 years of education)

scholarships.scholarshipName: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship for Undergraduate Students
scholarships.providerName: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
scholarships.description: Fully funded 5-year undergraduate scholarship programme including 1-year preparatory Japanese language training and 4-year degree studies in Japanese universities.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Completed 12 years of formal education. Born between April 2, 2002 and April 1, 2009. Academic excellence in mathematics, sciences and English.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) for Graduate Degrees
scholarships.providerName: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education
scholarships.description: Designed to provide international students with opportunities to conduct advanced studies in higher educational institutions in the Republic of Korea. Includes round-trip airfare, full tuition, and monthly stipend.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Applicant and parents must not hold Korean citizenship. Under 40 years of age. Bachelor's or Master's degree with cumulative GPA above 80% on 100-point scale.
eligibleSubjects: All academic fields offered by designated Korean universities

qualifications: Bachelor's degree for Master, Master's degree for PhD

scholarships.scholarshipName: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) for Undergraduate Degrees
scholarships.providerName: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education
scholarships.description: Korean government scholarship for international students seeking 4-year bachelor's degrees preceded by 1-year Korean language training.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: International students who have graduated from high school. Under 25 years of age. Cumulative GPA score of 80% or higher.

scholarships.providerName: Government of Canada (CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC)
scholarships.description: Canada's flagship doctoral awards program, valued at $50,000 per year for three years during doctoral studies at Canadian institutions.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Canadian and international citizens nominated by only one Canadian institution. Seeking first doctoral degree with top-level academic excellence, research potential, and demonstrated leadership.

qualifications: Master's degree with first-class average in last two years

scholarships.providerName: Government of Canada
scholarships.description: Prestigious Canadian postdoctoral fellowship providing $70,000 per year for two years to top national and international postdoctoral researchers.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: PhD, PhD-equivalent or health professional degree completed within the past 3 years. Institutional endorsement from a Canadian host institution.

scholarships.providerName: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT)
scholarships.description: Funded through the New Zealand Aid Programme, providing full tuition, living allowances, medical insurance and travel for partner country scholars.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: Citizen of eligible developing country (including India, Pacific, Southeast Asia). Minimum 18 years of age. Commits to returning to home country for 2 years post study.

qualifications: Meet university academic and English language criteria

scholarships.scholarshipName: New Zealand University International Doctoral Research Grants
scholarships.providerName: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT)
scholarships.description: Special funding enabling high-calibre international doctoral researchers to study at domestic student tuition fee rates alongside university stipend support in New Zealand.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: International students accepted into full-time doctoral research study at an accredited university in New Zealand.

qualifications: Honours or master's degree with demonstrated research capacity

scholarships.scholarshipName: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education in Schools for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
scholarships.providerName: Government of India — PM YASASVI scheme
scholarships.description: The National Scholarship Portal announcement for academic year 2026–27 reports that fresh applications are open for this scheme. It says students from Rajasthan, Keralam and Karnataka must wait for further notice. The announcement does not publish an application deadline or award amount.
scholarships.eligibilityDetails: The current portal announcement names OBC, EBC and DNT students. It instructs students with disabilities to complete UDID portal consent before submitting through NSP. Full eligibility, state availability, award details and deadline must be checked on the official portal; this record is awaiting full verification and is not an eligibility decision.
